_river_klickitat.refFlowBasis: Median USGS daily mean discharge, Apr–Jul 2021–2025 (USGS Water Data API daily, 00060/00003)
_river_klickitat.refSpeedBasis: Unchanged at 4.5 mph @ 1800 cfs (batch 1 review, 2026-10-25). Sourced points on gauge 14113000: 10.9 mi in 2 h at 2300 cfs reporter-stated (5.45 mph, Icehouse-Turkey Hole, AW Apr 2024); 21 mi in 3 h at 4600 cfs (7.0 mph, AW Mar 2026); 15.8 mi in <=6 h with fishing stops at 1040 cfs (>=2.6 mph; day-1 clock times imply ~3 mph with stops; AW Jun 2026). Linear interpolation between 1040 cfs (2.6-3.0 mph with stops, so a conservative low end) and 2300 cfs (5.45 mph, on the steeper lower section) gives about 4.3-4.5 mph at 1800 cfs, consistent with 4.5. No dated trip near 1800 cfs exists yet.

_river_cowlitz.refSpeedBasis: Unchanged at 4.0 mph @ 3000 cfs (batch 1 review, 2026-10-25). The v1 basis ('under 2 hr at ~2,400 cfs') mixed two AW reports. Sourced points on gauge 14238000: 7.5 mi in just under 2 h including a 20-min stop at 5090 cfs USGS daily mean (about 4.5 mph moving, into a strong headwind; AW Mar 2025); about 21.5 mi in about 4 h at 5160 cfs daily mean (5.4 mph; AW Jun 2024); outfitter CowlitzKayak 'average 2 hours' Barrier Dam-Blue Creek (3.75 mph, no flow); guidebook author 1-2 h (KATU 2021, no flow). Summer releases are typically ~2400-3500 cfs, so the outfitter average (3.75 mph) is close to 4.0. There is no dated 3000-cfs trip yet.
